command_basis: New driver admits exactly one unchanged full-ladder call per outer invocation, binds manifest package digest and ladder 1.4.0, refuses automatic attribution before execution, and counts old and new attempts against cap9. totals.prior_attempt_count_basis: All four old outer launches plus each new write-ahead launch are retained. All non-selected attempts remain in prior_attempts. Native admission is distinct from a trial-bearing job.
totals.wall_basis: Sum of measured final monotonic intervals, not total UTC elapsed. Including-prior values add measured retained monotonic intervals. Readiness and explicit publication remain separate.

limits: Deterministic model-free local controls, not model-performance evidence. No cloud or paid API execution.
A clean ladder cell means the fixed ladder earns no reward. A tamper-signature refusal does not semantically grade attacked task behavior.
Task resources remain 2 CPU and 8192 MiB. No Docker settings, task packages, attacks, verifier, rewards or host-isolation logic change.
Monotonic active elapsed and UTC elapsed are distinct. Old2377 has a large measured difference with no established cause; sleep is only an inference.
Queue time, census-only duration and image size/id are not measured separately.
Manifest verify status is unchanged. No oracle, nop, model evaluation or fix-content probe runs for these cells.
